sync.title: Local copy and sync
sync.desc_on: Your data is kept on this device and works without internet. Changes are sent to the server in the background.
sync.desc_off: Local mode is off for this business; the app talks to the server directly.
sync.storage_not_persisted: The browser may clear this storage when space is low
sync.locked_grace: This device has been offline for too long. Connect to the internet to keep working.
sync.clock_back: The device clock was set back; the offline time limit keeps counting.
sync.owner_switch_hint: Turn on or off for every device of this business.
sync.conflict_title: Orders that could not be accepted
sync.conflict_help: These orders were made on this device but the server could not accept them as they were.
sync.code_price_changed: The price changed since this order was made.
sync.code_permission_denied: You are not allowed to do this.
sync.code_online_required: This payment needs an internet connection.
sync.logout_body: {{n}} order(s) on this device have not reached the server. Signing out now could lose them.
sync.logout_keep: Sign out and keep them for later
sync.offline_terminal: The card terminal needs an internet connection. Use cash or another method, or reconnect.
sync.locked_cannot_sell: Offline time limit reached. Connect to the internet before taking new orders.
sync.saved_offline: Saved on this device; it will be sent when the connection is back.
